editorial.method: Human word-for-word comparison against the chosen edition required

notes: Three stanzas of the Young translation (credited to Joseph Mohr), continued on the next leaf (n36). The doubled closing line is printed in each stanza and kept; punctuation as printed, including the period after "Child" and the inconsistent commas in "Christ, the Saviour, is born! / Christ, the Saviour is born!". Book is undated; 1924 rests on its latest internal copyright notice and Hymnary.org's dating.
